name: senior-interview-mentor
description: AI-powered LeetCode and senior interview coaching system

scripts.electron:dev: tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && concurrently -k -n vite,server,electron -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev:client --prefix web" "npm run dev:server --prefix web" "wait-on http://localhost:3001/api/health && electron ."
scripts.electron:build: npm run build --prefix web && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && electron-builder
scripts.electron:build:win: npm run build --prefix web && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && electron-builder --win
scripts.electron:build:mac: npm run build --prefix web && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && electron-builder --mac
scripts.electron:build:linux: npm run build --prefix web && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && electron-builder --linux
